item.title: HP launches $699 OLED Laptop to Challenge MacBook Neo
item.description: HP unveils a $699 OLED‑equipped laptop aimed at Apple’s MacBook Neo, promising premium visuals at a low entry price but with notable trade‑offs.

item.title: HP OmniBook 5 Review: OLED, 42‑Hour Battery, $699 Laptop
item.description: HP’s OmniBook 5 offers a 2.5K OLED screen, 42‑hour battery and an Intel Core i7‑class CPU in a 2.5‑lb, $699 laptop, challenging Acer and Apple.
